firstPlayerRule: Players secretly choose two cards and select one as their leading card. Reveal those initiatives and a card for each monster type present; the lowest initiative acts first.
officialTieBreak: For tied players, compare their non-leading cards; if still tied, the players decide. A player acts before a monster type with the same initiative. Players decide ties between monster types.
clarifications: Initiative is determined again each round. A long rest has initiative 99; it can only be chosen when the character has at least two cards in their discard pile.
